data.title: WHO says Yemen health system at ‘breaking point’
data.description: GENEVA - The escalating fighting in Yemen is pushing the country’s health system to “breaking point”, the World Health Organization said on Tuesday, warning that diseases like cholera were already circulating widely.

data.title: Tom Cruise trades stunts for satire as toxic tycoon ‘Digger’
data.description: PARIS - Tom Cruise is taking on one of his riskiest roles in decades, tackling the politics of climate change and corporate greed in new film “Digger”, in which he plays an embattled, ageing tycoon.

data.title: Spain to ban evictions until 2030 amid housing protests
data.description: MADRID - Spain’s government, under pressure from nationwide housing protests, on Tuesday approved measures including a proposed ban on evictions until 2030 and the automatic renewal of tenant contracts, a minister said.

data.title: French far right battles antisemitism claims
data.description: PARIS - Jordan Bardella, a key ally of French far-right presidential frontrunner Marine Le Pen, on Tuesday said allegations he made antisemitic comments in 2013 marked part of a “total war” against their party ahead of the 2027 polls.

data.title: Mystery over UK airbase scare after no explosives found
data.description: FAIRFORD, England - A UK investigation into a suspected bomb plot at an airbase used by the United States was mired in confusion on Tuesday, after media reported no explosives were detected in vehicles seized nearby.

data.title: Settler attack in West Bank injures Israeli forces
data.description: JALUD, Palestinian Territories - More than 100 Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank early Tuesday, drawing rare Israeli government condemnation after they injured three members of the security forces.

data.title: Estonia decries Russian ‘sabotage’ of defence company
data.description: TALLINN, Estonia - Estonia’s foreign minister on Tuesday accused Russia of “sabotage” following an August arson attack on a defence company, Milrem Robotics, a claim the Kremlin immediately rejected.

data.title: Myanmar airstrike toll hits 50 as families gather dead
data.description: KYAUKTAW, Myanmar - Families searched for bodies on Tuesday around a charred market in western Myanmar after a military airstrike killed 50 people, one of the deadliest recent bombardments in the civil war.

data.title: UN concerned by Malaysia returns of Myanmar migrants
data.description: GENEVA — The United Nations (UN) voiced worry Tuesday as Malaysia started sending thousands of Myanmar nationals back to the war-torn country, warning that conditions there would not enable "safe, dignified and sustainable returns".

data.title: AI bosses head to White House as safety pressure builds
data.description: WASHINGTON - Leading artificial intelligence executives were preparing to meet at the White House on Tuesday with President Donald Trump and a top Republican as the US Congress calls for stronger industry oversight.

data.title: Indonesia charges train driver over crash that killed 16 women
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian police charged a train driver Tuesday with failing to brake in time to prevent a crash that killed 16 women near Jakarta in April, an official said.

data.title: North Korean DMZ landmine blast 'violation of armistice'
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's defence chief said Tuesday that the preliminary findings of an investigation into last week's landmine explosion inside the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) found North Korea responsible, saying the blast violated the armistice agreement.

data.title: Myanmar airstrike death toll rises to 50
data.description: NAY PYI TAW — The death toll from a military airstrike in west Myanmar rose to 50 on Tuesday, two local aid workers at the scene said, the day after it struck a busy market.

data.title: Malaysia begins sending home Myanmar refugees despite safety concerns
data.description: LUMUT, Malaysia - Malaysia began the process of deporting around 1,500 Myanmar nationals on Tuesday as part of a refugee repatriation programme, defying objections from the United Nations and dozens of human rights groups.

data.title: Vietnam arrests three on terrorism charges, including Norwegian and Australian citizens
data.description: HO CHI MINH — Vietnam police have ⁠arrested ⁠three people, including a Norwegian ​citizen and an Australian national of Vietnamese origin, accusing them of terrorism, in ​an operation that a pro-democracy group says ‌was conducted in Cambodia.

data.title: 8.3 million refugees at risk due to 'severe' funding cuts: UN
data.description: GENEVA - Nearly 8.3 million refugees and other forcibly displaced people face losing vital assistance from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), the UN's refugee agency warned Tuesday, as protection services crumble due to "severe" funding cuts.

data.title: Central Tokyo records 34 consecutive days of rain, longest on record
data.description: Central Tokyo on Tuesday registered 34 consecutive days of rain, marking the longest streak on record, according to the weather agency.

data.title: Brazil's cellphone crime: a security nightmare in every pocket
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO - Eduardo Metzker, 29, was riding his motorcycle in Rio de Janeiro when he was suddenly boxed in by two other bikes. One of the riders put a gun to his head and demanded his phone and passcode.

data.title: Pope says concerns about AI 'should be taken seriously'
data.description: ABOARD THE PAPAL PLANE - Pope Leo XIV on Monday warned concerns about artificial intelligence "should be taken seriously" but added he was not in "panic mode".

data.title: SpaceX puts Starship megarocket in orbit for first time
data.description: SOUTH PADRE ISLAND (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's Starship megarocket reached orbit for the first time on Monday after blasting off from Texas, in a major milestone for SpaceX's future plans, including trips to the Moon and Mars.
